MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which pair of syllables has the same initial and final but a different meaning because of the tone? (1 mark)
   A. nǐ (you) and hǎo (good)
   B. bā (eight) and mā (mother)
   C. dà (big) and xiǎo (small)
   D. mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)

2. Which pair of initials both use a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. b and d
   B. m and n
   C. b and g
   D. p and t

3. Which sentence means "That is my older brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我妈妈。
   B. 这是谁?
   C. 那是我哥哥。
   D. 我爱你。

4. What does 妹妹 (mèimei) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who
   B. Mother
   C. To have, there is
   D. Younger sister

5. Which word is pronounced érzi? (1 mark)
   A. 这
   B. 女儿
   C. 儿子
   D. 是

6. What does 冰箱 (bīngxiāng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beside
   B. Fridge
   C. Sofa
   D. Left side

7. In the sentence 电视在桌子上, where is the television? (1 mark)
   A. Beside the door
   B. Under the table
   C. In the kitchen
   D. On the table

8. What does 星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To rest
   B. Seven
   C. Friday
   D. Mosque

9. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期五,去清真寺。
   B. 我星期三去学校。
   C. 星期天,去教堂。
   D. 今天星期三。

10. What are the three steps of good imitation? (1 mark)
   A. Talk, sleep, walk
   B. Read, draw, colour
   C. Copy, hide, forget
   D. Listen, repeat, compare and correct

11. Which of these is a staple food that gives the body energy? (1 mark)
   A. 水 water
   B. 茶 tea
   C. 咖啡 coffee
   D. 米饭 rice

12. Which food group does 菠菜 belong to? (1 mark)
   A. Meat
   B. Vegetables
   C. Fruits
   D. Drinks

13. What does 我喜欢吃香蕉 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a banana tree
   B. I do not like bananas
   C. I like to eat bananas
   D. I am eating tea

14. Which body word is a single character, one you can write with 3 strokes? (1 mark)
   A. 目 mù (eye)
   B. 头 tóu (head)
   C. 口 kǒu (mouth)
   D. 耳 ěr (ear)

15. What does 干旱 (gānhàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Weather
   B. It rains
   C. Drought
   D. Also

16. What does 你好 (nǐ hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To be called
   B. I, me
   C. Hello
   D. Classmates

17. What does 再见 (zàijiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good morning
   B. Hello
   C. Classmates
   D. Goodbye

18. What does 爸爸 (bàba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Father
   C. Younger brother
   D. Is, am, are

19. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子上____? (Is the television on the table?) (1 mark)
   A. 的
   B. 呢
   C. 了
   D. 吗

20. What does 七 (qī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Ten
   C. Six
   D. Five

21. What is a reading journal for? (1 mark)
   A. Listing chores
   B. Storing food
   C. Keeping words and sentences you have learnt
   D. Playing games only

22. What does 生日 (shēngrì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Birthday
   B. To come
   C. Cake
   D. Happy

23. What does 芒果 (mángguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To like
   B. Coffee
   C. Biscuits
   D. Mango

24. Which Chinese word means "to speak"? (1 mark)
   A. 耳朵 ěrduo
   B. 牙 yá
   C. 说 shuō
   D. 笑 xiào

25. What does 笑 (xiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To look, to see
   B. To laugh, to smile
   C. To brush teeth
   D. Nose

26. Which word is pronounced bízi? (1 mark)
   A. 用
   B. 鼻子
   C. 肩膀
   D. 牙

27. Which sentence means "The weather is very good today."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 今天下雨。
   C. 今天有云。
   D. 雨很大。

28. Why do we pause when we read aloud? (1 mark)
   A. To forget words
   B. To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   C. To read faster
   D. To change tones

29. What does 早上 zǎoshang mean? (1 mark)
   A. Night
   B. Morning
   C. Afternoon
   D. Evening

30. What can help you work out the meaning of an unknown word? (1 mark)
   A. The size of the book
   B. Nothing
   C. The colour of the paper
   D. Clues in the words and pictures around it

31. Which Chinese word means "to be called"? (1 mark)
   A. 叫 jiào
   B. 谢谢 xièxie
   C. 再见 zàijiàn
   D. 您好 nín hǎo

32. What does 女儿 (nǚ'ér) mean? (1 mark)
   A. And
   B. Daughter
   C. Is, am, are
   D. Younger sister

33. Why is correct spelling with tones important? (1 mark)
   A. Tones do not matter
   B. Only capital letters matter
   C. Only characters matter
   D. A wrong tone can change the meaning

34. Which Chinese word means "school"? (1 mark)
   A. 昨天 zuótiān
   B. 学校 xuéxiào
   C. 去 qù
   D. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì

35. Which Chinese word means "plate"? (1 mark)
   A. 祝 zhù
   B. 月 yuè
   C. 盘子 pánzi
   D. 蜡烛 làzhú

36. What does 刀 (dāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To give (a gift)
   B. Month
   C. Knife
   D. Candle

37. What does 杯子 (bēizi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cup
   B. We
   C. To give (a gift)
   D. To wish

38. Read the pinyin: wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like to drink tea.
   B. This is a banana.
   C. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   D. I drink tea.

39. Which sentence means "The wind is very light."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 风很小。
   D. 今天下雨。

40. Which sentence means "The sun is very big."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 太阳很大。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 雨很大。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Break the syllables hǎo, jiào and nǐ into initial and final. (3 marks)

42. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào. (2 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 脚 and 休息. (2 marks)

44. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ ài nǐ. (2 marks)

45. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" and "Thank you!" (4 marks)

46. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 明天 and 二. (2 marks)

47. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期二 and 晚饭. (2 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 祝 and 电视. (2 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Sunday, go to church." (3 marks)

50. Explain how you can guess the meaning of 咖啡 in 我喝咖啡. (3 marks)

51. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my mouth to speak." (2 marks)

52. Write a paragraph of four sentences about your week in Chinese with pinyin, using the days and activities from this lesson. (5 marks)

53. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: jīntiān xià yǔ. (2 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛肉 and 女儿. (2 marks)

55. Read and translate: 星期一到星期五,去学校。 (3 marks)

56. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 椅子 and 谁. (2 marks)

57. Give the Mandarin words for older brother, younger brother and younger sister, with pinyin. (3 marks)

58. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is a banana." (2 marks)

59. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天 and 老师. (2 marks)

60. Explain what tone, volume and vocal projection mean when reading aloud. (3 marks)

61. Write a plan for a model house: name four rooms or things in Chinese with pinyin and write one sentence about it. (4 marks)

62. Give two reasons why it is important to place household items in their right places. (2 marks)

63. Explain why tones are important in Mandarin. Give one example with meanings. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — mā (mother) and mǎ (horse)
   Only the tone separates mā and mǎ.

2. D — p and t
   p, t and k are said with a puff of air.

3. C — 那是我哥哥。
   那是我哥哥。 (nà shì wǒ gēge.) means "That is my older brother.".

4. D — Younger sister
   妹妹 (mèimei) means younger sister.

5. C — 儿子
   儿子 is pronounced érzi and means son.

6. B — Fridge
   冰箱 (bīngxiāng) means fridge.

7. D — On the table
   上 means on.

8. C — Friday
   星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) means Friday.

9. D — 今天星期三。
   今天星期三。 (jīntiān xīngqīsān.) means "Today is Wednesday.".

10. D — Listen, repeat, compare and correct
   Good imitation means listening carefully, repeating, then comparing with the speaker.

11. D — 米饭 rice
   Staple foods such as rice give energy.

12. B — Vegetables
   菠菜 is spinach.

13. C — I like to eat bananas
   喜欢 is like, 吃 is eat and 香蕉 is banana.

14. C — 口 kǒu (mouth)
   口 has three strokes; 头 has 5, 耳 has 6 and 目 has 5.

15. C — Drought
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

16. C — Hello
   你好 (nǐ hǎo) means hello.

17. D — Goodbye
   再见 (zàijiàn) means goodbye.

18. B — Father
   爸爸 (bàba) means father.

19. D — 吗
   吗 turns the statement into a yes-or-no question.

20. A — Seven
   七 (qī) means seven.

21. C — Keeping words and sentences you have learnt
   A journal helps you review and check your progress.

22. A — Birthday
   生日 (shēngrì) means birthday.

23. D — Mango
   芒果 (mángguǒ) means mango.

24. C — 说 shuō
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

25. B — To laugh, to smile
   笑 (xiào) means to laugh, to smile.

26. B — 鼻子
   鼻子 is pronounced bízi and means nose.

27. A — 今天天气很好。
   今天天气很好。 (jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.) means "The weather is very good today.".

28. B — To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   Pauses help the reader and the listener.

29. B — Morning
   早上 is morning.

30. D — Clues in the words and pictures around it
   Context gives clues.

31. A — 叫 jiào
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

32. B — Daughter
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

33. D — A wrong tone can change the meaning
   chuáng and chuāng are different words.

34. B — 学校 xuéxiào
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

35. C — 盘子 pánzi
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

36. C — Knife
   刀 (dāo) means knife.

37. A — Cup
   杯子 (bēizi) means cup.

38. C — For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. is 我早饭吃饼。, which means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

39. C — 风很小。
   风很小。 (fēng hěn xiǎo.) means "The wind is very light.".

40. B — 太阳很大。
   太阳很大。 (tàiyáng hěn dà.) means "The sun is very big.".

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: hǎo = h + ao; jiào = j + iao; nǐ = n + i.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct syllable.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Wednesday I go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 脚: jiǎo, foot. 休息: xiūxi, to rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: I love you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn! 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 明天: míngtiān, tomorrow. 二: èr, two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期二: xīngqī'èr, Tuesday. 晚饭: wǎnfàn, dinner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝: zhù, to wish. 电视: diànshì, television.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期天,去教堂。 xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: The verb 喝 means to drink, so 咖啡 must be a drink. A picture can also help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verb clue, 1 mark for the conclusion, 1 mark for another clue.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用嘴巴说。 wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一到星期五,我去学校。星期六,我在家休息。星期天,我去教堂。 xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, wǒ qù xuéxiào. xīngqīliù, wǒ zài jiā xiūxi. xīngqītiān, wǒ qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for order and punctuation. Any sensible activities.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today it rains.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 牛肉: niúròu, beef. 女儿: nǚ'ér, daughter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, qù xuéxiào. From Monday to Friday, go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin and 2 marks for the meaning.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: 椅子: yǐzi, chair. 谁: shéi, who.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: 哥哥 gēge, 弟弟 dìdi, 妹妹 mèimei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with pinyin.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天: tiān, sky, day. 老师: lǎoshī, teacher.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tone is the rise and fall of each syllable, volume is how loud you speak and projection is sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

61. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 厨房 chúfáng, 客厅 kètīng, 卧室 wòshì, 床 chuáng. Sentence: 床在卧室。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name with pinyin, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the house tidy and safe, and it is easier to find things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: The tone changes the meaning of a word. For example mā means mother but mǎ means horse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying tone changes meaning, 2 marks for a correct pair with meanings.
